main.description: Tier 2 domain record for an in-between frame (動画 / douga). Generated between two consecutive keyframes, either by the inbetweener AI actor (`method=aiInterp`) or by a human animator (`method=manual`).

frameNum.description: Frame number within the cut (0-indexed). Must be strictly between prevKey.frameNum and nextKey.frameNum.

prevKeyRef.description: Previous keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

nextKeyRef.description: Next keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

method.description: How this frame was produced. 'reuse' = copy of adjacent frame (holdout).

author.description: Human DID or inbetweener actor DID.
